subtitle: Reusing a proven real pattern, not inventing a new one

code:
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: { python-version: "3.11" }
      - run: pip install dbt-snowflake==1.7.4
      - run: dbt deps
caption: Same shape as this path's Git/CI-CD course — dbt-snowflake, not dbt-postgres.

code:
- name: Create profiles.yml
  run: |
    cat <<EOF > ~/.dbt/profiles.yml
    jaffle_shop:
      target: ci
      outputs:
        ci:
          type: snowflake
          account: "{{ env_var('SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT') }}"
          schema: ci
    EOF
caption: Generated fresh every run — nothing sensitive ever committed.
dbt build, into its own disposable ci schema — never dev, never prod.
